tagline: Regulated energy infrastructure provider serving California and Texas
hero_kpi_rationale: Major growth of combined rate base of 18% in 2025, reflecting significant capital investments in transmission and distribution network safety and reliability, the primary long-term profitability driver for regulated utilities
company_description: Sempra engages in the regulated utilities business in the United States and Mexico. It operates through three segments: Sempra California, Sempra Texas Utilities, and Sempra Infrastructure. It also invests in and operates electric and gas utilities and other energy infrastructure that provides energy services to customers. The Sempra California segment provides natural gas and electric services to Southern California and part of central California. As of December 31, 2025, it offered electric services to approximately 3.6 million population and natural gas services to approximately 3.3 million population that covers 4,100 square miles. This segment owns and operates a natural gas distribution, transmission, and storage system that supplies natural gas. As of December 31, 2025, it served a population of 21.3 million covering an area of 24,000 square miles. The Sempra Texas Utilities segment engages in the regulated electricity transmission and distribution utility business. risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: Changes in regulations and regulatory authority decisions can have a significant impact on the company's results and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Regulators (CPUC, FERC, PUCT) can modify rules and authorized rates of return, which could impact company results. The company experienced $432M in disallowances in 2025.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage its debt to maintain its credibility and access to credit at attractive rates.
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt and changes in credit conditions could impact its ability to finance capital investments.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: Interest rate fluctuations can have a significant impact on financing costs and company results.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can impact the value of the company's assets and liabilities and the financing costs of capital investments.

risks.title: Asset Depreciation and Impairment Risk
risks.summary: Asset depreciations and impairments can have a significant negative impact on company results and equity value.
risks.score_rationale: Company assets, notably SI Partners and Ecogas (classified as held-for-sale assets), may require significant impairments in case of changes in market or regulatory conditions.

risks.title: Tax and FX Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage its tax obligations and FX exposure to minimize negative impacts on results.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in tax laws and FX rate fluctuations (particularly in Mexico) can impact company results. The FX impact in 2025 was $445M unfavorable.

risks.title: Pension Plan Risk
risks.summary: Pension plans can impact company costs and its ability to attract and retain qualified employees.
risks.score_rationale: Company pension plans may require significant contributions in case of changes in market or demographic conditions.
